name: Pylon
one_liner: Platform for issues, accounts, contacts and knowledge base, exposed through a REST API and MCP server.
auth_notes: REST API uses a Bearer API token created by an Admin, with US and EU regional base URLs. The MCP server additionally accepts OAuth 2.0.
access_notes: Only Admins can create and manage API tokens, under Settings > Integrations & dev > API. Tokens do not expire and an optional IP allowlist applies. Cost and plan gating for the REST API are not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Admins self-serve Bearer tokens for a documented REST API with pagination and rate-limit docs. No REST plan gate appears on the fetched pages, but confirm plan access before building.

identity.quote: Programmatic access to read and write data in Pylon

auth.quote: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication.

access.quote: Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.
